result.rationale: The diff's own comment in refreshOAuthTokens.ts says the sync endpoint response 'should only contain the access token and expiry date', while the minimumTokenResponseSchema only requires access_token. The office365video adapter routes that response into handleErrorsJson<ITokenResponse> and uses its fields (expires_in, token_type, refresh_token), which plausibly won't be present, causing NaN expiry/persisted undefined fields. The exact downstream field reads aren't in the diff, so it's partially unverifiable, but the mechanism is grounded in the shown code.

judged_text: In sharing mode the response handed to handleErrorsJson<ITokenResponse> is {access_token, expiry}, missing the expires_in/refresh_token/token_type fields the MS Teams adapter reads from it. Under credential sync the Teams adapter computes a NaN expiry and persists undefined token fields, triggering a refresh attempt on every call and failing meeting creation once the stale access token expires.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens()` which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, calls the external sync endpoint and explicitly documents that “The response should only contain the access token and expiry date” (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). Other adapters that parse refreshed tokens (e.g., Office365 calendar and Zoom) were updated to use `parseRefreshTokenResponse()` to accept a minimal `{access_token, <number-expiry>}` shape under sharing mode. However, the MS Teams adapter (packages/app-store/office365video/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts) was only switched to use `refreshOAuthTokens()` and still passes the raw response into `handleErrorsJson<ITokenResponse>(response)` without the relaxed parsing layer, implying it still expects the full `ITokenResponse` shape. Under sharing mode this can break or propagate missing fields because the sync endpoint response is intentionally minimal, matching the finding’s core claim that sharing mode can yield missing token fields for the Teams adapter.
